caption: The drawing depicts a carriage pulled by two white horses, all constructed with the forms and simplified details characteristic of a toy. The horses are positioned side by side and attached to a green base with four black wheels. Both horses have black hooves, open mouths with visible red tongues, gray shading, and red straps around their necks. The carriage is connected to the horses’ base with a rod. The carriage itself has a large, curved, dark green canopy with black shadows, and the interior is shaded with purples and browns. The seat inside the carriage is red with black scrolling designs and accommodates a single figure. The figure is a woman wearing a yellowish-brown dress with green accents around the collar and cuffs, and she has brown hair styled up and away from her face. The carriage stands on two large wheels at the rear and two smaller front wheels. The entire composition is contained within a simple black-lined rectangular border on a beige or cream background, with no other ornamental or scenic elements present.
title: Calash
